settings.localMcp.title: Local MCP server
settings.localMcp.description: Connect a trusted AI client to the project you explicitly opened in Lingua. The server stays local, session-only, and read-only.
settings.localMcp.status.label: Server status
settings.localMcp.status.stoppedHint: No MCP endpoint or access token is active.
settings.localMcp.scope.label: Approved project
settings.localMcp.scope.hint: Every tool call is checked against this live project capability.
settings.localMcp.consent.label: I understand this token grants read access to my project source.
settings.localMcp.consent.hint: Only share it with a client you trust. Lingua blocks writes, execution, network access, binary files, and common secret files, but source code itself may contain sensitive information.
settings.localMcp.desktopOnly: The local server is available in the desktop app only.
settings.localMcp.openProject: Open a desktop project before starting the server.
settings.localMcp.ready: Starting creates a new loopback port and one-time session token.
settings.localMcp.connection.title: Connection ready
settings.localMcp.connection.hint: Add these values to an MCP client that supports HTTP headers. Stopping the server invalidates them immediately.
settings.localMcp.security.title: Trust boundary
settings.localMcp.security.loopback.hint: Binds to 127.0.0.1 and validates Host and Origin to block LAN exposure and DNS rebinding.
settings.localMcp.security.token.title: Session token
settings.localMcp.security.token.hint: A random token protects every request and is never persisted, logged, or sent in telemetry.
settings.localMcp.security.readOnly.hint: Clients may inspect bounded project text, but cannot write, run commands, install packages, or make network calls.
settings.localMcp.security.lifecycle.hin: The server stops when you close or switch projects, close Lingua, or press Stop.
settings.localMcp.error.invalid-acknowle: Confirm the read-access acknowledgement before starting the server.
settings.localMcp.error.invalid-project: The approved project is no longer available. Reopen it and try again.
settings.localMcp.error.listen-failed: Lingua could not create the loopback endpoint. Try again.
settings.localMcp.error.owner-destroyed: The window closed before the server finished starting.
settings.localMcp.error.unavailable: The local MCP server could not be updated. Try again.
settings.localMcp.error.copy: The value could not be copied. Check clipboard permission and try again.
